construction: Two shallow paired seats integral with the cold-core lid. One common narrow zip tie per station passes through a transverse slot beneath the seat. Open mouths beside the tubes expose the slot for threading. The aft seat extends from the lid edge to support the outboard tube.
scope: Arrangement-study retaining geometry. Tube centerlines and component poses are fixed. Native lid fusion and access cuts are supplied by the builder for production integration. Tie strips are nominal occupied-space witnesses, not purchased-part measurements.
